title: Cavestone Update
description: Dive into a mod that adds brand new sets of blocks in the caves!
body:
Downloading this mob you will have brand new blocks! Dive into the new Amethyst, Dripstone, Andesite, Granite, Calcite and Diorite sets.

Craft them by putting their original block in a Stonecutter and be ready to build majestic and awesome new build, never seen before.

Mod for 1.21.4 Neo forge, you can use it together with my other 3 Mods (Deep Rays Update, Power Gems Update and Building Update) because they are for the same version.

Creator: ItzFedd, thanks for reading the description :) enjoy my mods!
